rows.name: columns
rows.description: Column definitions. Each is { key: string; header: ReactNode; cell: (row: T) => ReactNode; dataLabel?: string } — cell renders one row's value for that column.

rows.name: rows
rows.description: The row data, one table row each.

rows.name: getRowKey
rows.description: Stable React key for a row.

rows.name: toolbar
rows.description: Toolbar slot above the table (search, filters, bulk select). Rendered on the left of the top row.

rows.name: pagination
rows.description: Pagination slot rendered top-right. Give it a distinct titles.paginationAriaLabel if you also render footerPagination.

rows.name: footerPagination
rows.description: Pagination slot rendered below the table (typically variant="bottom").

rows.name: isLoading
rows.description: Show a centered spinner in place of rows.

rows.name: emptyState
rows.description: Rendered when rows is empty and not loading — e.g. a <StatusPanel variant="empty">.
